Scheduled Apex nesting at Test.stopTest. Owned synthetic capture, 2026-10-22, on a
one-day scratch org created for this capture.

Rows in org.tsv were transcribed from the raw observation files of capture
sched-inner-20261022, with no edits to the observation text:
- obs/api62-deploytests.txt -> 62.0 deploy (19 rows)
- obs/api67-deploytests.txt -> 67.0 deploy (19 rows)
- obs/api68-deploytests.txt -> 68.0 deploy (19 rows)
- obs/api68-synchronous-runtests-SchedCapTest-v01-v10.txt -> 68.0 synchronous (10 rows)
- obs/api68-synchronous-runtests-SchedCapTest2-w01-w06.txt -> 68.0 synchronous (6 rows)
Every obs line maps to one row. No line was dropped.

Classes in cases.json are the captured SchedCap* sources, byte for byte. They already use
synthetic names, so no class was renamed. Each API was deployed with matching class and
sourceApiVersion metadata.

Routes (both are named @IsTest runs; locally both bind to the named @IsTest route):
- deploy: sf project deploy start --test-level RunSpecifiedTests, at API 62.0, 67.0, 68.0,
  all 19 variants (SchedCapTest v01-v10, SchedCapTest2 w01-w09).
- synchronous: sf apex run test --synchronous at API 68.0, SchedCapTest v01-v10 and
  SchedCapTest2 w01-w06. Every test reports Fail, because each one ends in
  System.assert(false, <observation>) to carry the observation.
Not captured: anonymous Apex, which cannot call Test.startTest or Test.stopTest.

Observation: "OBS <label> batch=<n> sched=<n> [queue=<n>] cron=<n>", the counts of Accounts
named batch-side-effect, scheduled-side-effect and queue-side-effect, and of CronTrigger
rows whose CronJobDetail.Name starts with SchedCap, read after Test.stopTest. Method
w05InnerBatchNoSeedQuery labels its observation w05PreCounts.

Result, identical in every route and API:
- A top-level Schedulable (SchedCapJob) passed to System.schedule runs at Test.stopTest
  (sched=1). This holds for cron years 2050 and 2099, alone, with a batch (scope 1 or the
  default) or a queueable, in either order, and when scheduled before Test.startTest.
- An inner-class Schedulable (SchedCapHelper.InnerJob, SchedCapTest2.TestInnerJob) does
  not run (sched=0), and its CronTrigger row remains (cron=1).
- A batch alone runs and creates no CronTrigger.

Corroboration, not stored as rows: the salesforce-correctness CorrectnessProbeTest class
passed 12/12 in deploy mode at API 68.0. That includes sfLifecycleStopTestBatchScheduled,
an inner-class Schedulable after a batch.
